title: Higher Education: Reflections and Ideation
subtitle: This blog seeks to stimulate and promote the discourse for transformation of our understanding of objectives, required content, and desirable processes of higher education, especially engineering and computing education in India. Many articles also focus on Outcome-Based Education, Active Learning, Project-Based Learning, Accreditation, Ranking, Innovation, as well as interdisciplinary trends and opportunities for integrating IT with other disciplines.
